concept: two dog breeds on one skeleton
idea: A German Shepherd and a Rottweiler share a dog's skeleton and gait; what tells them apart is drawn on top: ears, head shape, coat colour and markings, and the tail.

parameters.name: speed
parameters.why: From standing to a gallop, so both breeds move in the gait their shared bones give.

moves: Both dogs move on the spot over a ground that slides under them, in the same gait, because they have the same bones.
steps: A German Shepherd: tall ears and a black saddle
A Rottweiler: a broad head and tan points
